name: White Tigers (Yakuza Gang)
body:
A yakuza who belongs to this gang is focused and determined on achieving any task that comes before them. They are relentless and never turn aside, especially when in pursuit of someone that has escaped the wrath of their masters. They will use every tool and talent at their disposal from stealth to subtle conversation to savage bloodshed, whatever is required to bring their target back dead or alive. Edict: The yakuza is loyal to the mission, plain and simple. They are aware that they are stronger than others, but they won’t hesitate to betray others in order to accomplish their goals. Fierce and determined, the yakuza live solely to advance the overall plans of their gang, knowing that the best way to do this is to use their allies when they can and abandon them when needed.

Sneak Attack: Whenever a white tiger yakuza makes an attack which would qualify for sneak attack damage against a foe being threatened by two or more allies (not including himself ), they gain a +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls against that foe.

Skills: Whenever a white tiger yakuza uses the Diplomacy skill to shift the attitude of a foe, they receive a bonus on the check equal to 1/3 their yakuza level (minimum +1).

Gang Abilities: A yakuza belonging to this gang gains the following abilities as they increases in level:

Kneecap (Ex)

At 2nd level, whenever a white tiger yakuza deals sneak attack damage to a foe, that foe’s speed is reduced by 5 feet for a number of rounds equal to the yakuza’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1). At 8th level and again at 16th, the foe’s speed is reduced by an additional 5 feet.

No Escape (Su)

At 8th level, whenever a white tiger yakuza deals sneak attack damage to a foe, they can spend 1 point from their ki; if they does, that foe cannot use the withdraw action or make a 5 foot step for a number of rounds equal to the yakuza’s Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Cornering Predator (Su)

At 15th level, whenever a white tiger yakuza deals sneak attack damage to a foe, they can spend 1 point from their ki; if they do, that foe’s speed is reduced to 0 feet and they must make a Reflex saving throw or be staggered for 1 round.
